|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous (V)]], under the new title; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-91-Armed_And_Dangerous_Krayt_Dragon_Howl-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The release-sheet slip shows the original card (see [[Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous (V)]]); the Players Committee card image and the Master List slip show the new title with the original text.
* '''Original''' ([[Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous (V)]]): printed as “•Krayt Dragon Howl & •Armed And Dangerous”, text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009) and its revised copy (20 April 2010)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>: “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Stunning Leader. OR If a battle was just initiated, ▼ (or deploy from hand) a character weapon on your participating character. LOST: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-91-Armed_And_Dangerous_Krayt_Dragon_Howl.png]]) prints it.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) renamed the card “Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl” and showed this text (the ▼ written out; “(or deploy from hand)” became “(or hand)” after “from Reserve Deck”)<ref name="cl-1261_93-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Stunning Leader. OR If a battle was just initiated, deploy a character weapon on your participating character from Reserve Deck (or hand); reshuffle. LOST: Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-91-Armed_And_Dangerous_Krayt_Dragon_Howl-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-armedanddangerous&kraytdragonhowl-pre.gif]], undated) and the Master List slip (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 32; [[:File:VL-history-1261-93-front-master.png]]) print the new title with the original text; the Master List copy of the text is a stale reprint, not a new version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
|hatnote=For the original printed text, see [[Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous (V)]].
